:::: {.hero}
# Practitioner Exchange

::: {.stand}
A three-day retreat for practitioners who want to lead groups with more
confidence. Knowing your practice well is one thing. Leading a group is
another.
:::
::::

::: {.band .band-practitioner}
:::

This three-day retreat gives around twelve wellness, bodymind and
movement practitioners a place to practise group facilitation with other
practitioners.
Each participant leads a session in their own practice and then gets feedback
from the group, with a simple structure for giving it. Along the way, you experience other
traditions from the inside and compare notes on what it takes to lead a group
well.

We look after the structure: daily opening and closing practices, a short
check-in with you before you lead, and time to reflect together. That leaves you
free to try new things as a facilitator, at the edge you choose.

:::: {.about}

::: {.ab}
[Led by]{.k}

[FG](../about/fg.qmd) and [DS](../about/ds.qmd), together.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Who it is for]{.k}

Teachers, therapists and practitioners who want to lead groups with more
confidence, presence and care. Adults (18+).
:::

::: {.ab}
[When]{.k}

Tentatively May 2027. Three days.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Where]{.k}

Germany.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Touch]{.k}

Some sessions may involve touch between participants, such as a hand on the
back or leaning into each other's weight, including sessions that other
participants lead. Touch is always optional: you can say no, or change your
mind, at any time without giving a reason, and there is always a way to take
part without it. Nothing in the retreat is sexual, and everyone stays clothed.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Included]{.k}

Accommodation and food.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Language]{.k}

English. Everyday English is enough.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Group]{.k}

Around twelve participants.
:::
